key_catalyst: Escalating broad rotation out of AI and semiconductor stocks amid demand and monetization concerns
reasoning: The AI-capex and semiconductor concern has escalated from scrutiny of Alphabet and Tesla on July 23-24 to a broad chip-led rotation on July 28 and continued severe selling in major AI suppliers today. With the FOMC outcome and Microsoft/Meta results still pending, the core QQQ risk is unresolved and could compound rather than fade during the session.
